This page records the history of my involvement in the course of the Linguistics Master's Program at the Faculty of Humanities, Udayana University.

# 2025 - now

- *Morfologi* (Morphology) (Course coordinator: Prof. Dr. Ni Luh Sutjiati Beratha; Members: Prof. Dr. I Nyoman Udayana ✝︎; __Gede Primahadi Wijaya Rajeg__, Ph.D.) - I am teaching the Corpus-based approach to morphology, using the Indonesian corpora as the data source - From Odd Semester 2025/2026

-   *Etika dan Metode Penelitian Bahasa* (Ethics and Methods in Language Research) (Course coordinator: Prof. Dr. I Wayan Pastika; Members: __Gede Primahadi Wijaya Rajeg__, Ph.D.; Dr Ni Made Ayu Widiastuti) - I am filling in for the Corpus Linguistics method - From Even Semester 2024/2025
